source_text: Voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) for adolescent boys and men in high-HIV-prevalence areas, backed by randomized trials demonstrating 50–60% risk reduction, is recommended by the WHO for public health, though debated in low-prevalence settings due to modest absolute benefits. [20]
